author: JunkoGG
quote:
Apart from good graphics and the amount of really immersive, potential interactions you can get, GTA 6 is generic, outdated, to bland as hell on other fronts. The story is eh, some stuffs you can do in GTA 5, you can't do some in 6, the lead characters are bland as hell, of all the GTA games so far, I like 6's color scheme. 

But man, it's so funny, that when Crimson Desert has lots of things you can interact within the game, J$urn$s call it a messy hodge podge of ideas hastily put together, but when GTA 6 does it, J$urn$s glaze it to hell n back.... Hmmm makes you really wonder. And some might say GTA 6 does it better... Really? Ya think so LMAO? I get that the Western Gaming Industry is in shambles right now and needs a big W before ending 2026, but man, damn lmao.

I'm alright with games getting overhyped, and this is GTA, of course it will be overhyped. I don't mind that. It's just that we've gotten so many amazing games throughout this year that carry either better story, better combat or better main/core gameplay, better characters, better art direction, better acting performances, better creative direction, and so on: RE 9, Pragmata, Onimusha, Crimson Desert, Phantom Blade, and way more within the Indie scene. They may not have the open-world scope GTA 6 has, but you don't need an open world to make a game, a game. And GTA 6 is again, really good on the graphical fidelity and world interaction potential part. But core gameplay? eh it's alright, it barely innovates like Pragmata, Onimusha, and RE 9 but whatever. Story? it's bland as hell, the leads are barely likeable especially Lucia. I don't like V's Trevor, but at least the guy's iconic/meme-able.

Overall, if you prefer a focused, much better core gameplay, better story and gameplay loop, GTA 6 may not click for you. This definitely sells for you if you're instead looking for an open-world game that's for sure, although if you ask me you're better off to either GTA V, Yakuza/Like a Dragon games, Crimson Desert, or better yet, ARKHAM KNIGHT!
